dataset_metadata.title: Closed-Loop Deep-Ocean Hydrothermal Vent Heat Engine & Desalination System
dataset_metadata.author: Thomas Krohmer, Environmental Systems Technologist
reference_frameworks: Reversed Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion (OTEC) Closed-Loop Architecture
MBARI Pacific Ring of Fire & Gulf of California Vent Mapping
dataset_metadata.systemic_classification: Clean Baseload Power, Distilled Water Production & Geopolitical Resource War Mitigation

engineering_architecture.core_modification: Inverts standard OTEC (which extracts cold deep water) by capturing extreme thermal heat (~400°C / 750°F) directly from volcanic ocean vents

capture_mechanism.collector: Insulated upside-down funnel positioned over the volcanic hydrothermal vent
capture_mechanism.alignment_guide: Initial seafloor positioning cylinder to center the funnel over the vent
capture_mechanism.ballast_and_insulation: Sand or heavy seafloor material layered over the funnel to anchor it and prevent thermal loss
capture_mechanism.heat_transfer: Internal heat exchanger positioned just before the inside spout of the funnel, feeding insulated steam pipes up to the surface platform

engineering_architecture.surface_infrastructure: Repurposed deep-sea ocean-going oil drilling platform housing the closed-loop turbine heat engine
engineering_architecture.environmental_advantage: Closed-loop design prevents toxic vent mineral plumes and heavy metals from mixing into ocean water or damaging turbines

performance_and_resource_outputs.vent_thermal_temperature: Up to 400°C (750°F) under high deep-sea pressure
performance_and_resource_outputs.single_vent_thermal_potential_mw: 15 MWe to 60 MW thermal (Marshall system upper benchmark targets ~5,000 MWe / 5 nuclear plants equivalent via multi-vent scaling)
performance_and_resource_outputs.primary_output_1: Continuous, zero-emission baseload electricity for coastal grids (e.g., California & Pacific Ring of Fire)
performance_and_resource_outputs.primary_output_2: Large-scale distilled freshwater byproduct ("Blue Gold") eliminating energy-intensive coastal desalination

macroeconomic_and_geopolitical_impact.blind_spot_identified: Short-term energy models favor fossil fuel extraction and centralized grids while ignoring water scarcity and resource-driven military conflicts.
macroeconomic_and_geopolitical_impact.required_correction: Deploy decentralized offshore hydrothermal platforms to secure independent clean energy and distilled water, eliminating root drivers of global resource wars.
